tldr: Evening batch — Sam Altman previews OpenAI's next model on Capitol Hill amid ongoing fallout from the HuggingFace breach, while Microsoft sharpens its competitive posture against both OpenAI and Anthropic. OpenAI's July ARR already topped all of Q2, signaling massive revenue acceleration. The Anthropic cryptanalysis story gains a technical deep-dive from a cryptography expert, and community momentum around Kimi K3 continues with GGUF quant progress, a new 256K-context variant, and a first-principles reading guide. A Science investigation finds AI's top startups are barely publishing their research anymore.

articles.title: Sam Altman Previews Next OpenAI Model on Capitol Hill After Cyber Breach
articles.summary: Altman previewed the next-gen model to lawmakers face-to-face days after the HuggingFace breach — signaling conciliation after a major AI security incident.

articles.title: Microsoft Now Openly Competing With OpenAI and Anthropic
articles.summary: Microsoft's AI strategy shifts from partner to rival — launching competing models, agents, and security products that directly overlap with its investees.

articles.title: OpenAI July Revenue Already Topped All of Q2
articles.summary: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar told employees July ARR alone exceeded the entire Q2 total — growth acceleration driven by enterprise and agent adoption.

articles.title: Anthropic's Cryptanalysis Results — A Cryptographer's Perspective
articles.summary: Leading cryptographer Matthew Green analyzes Anthropic's cipher-breaking AI results — rigorous, measured, and contextualizing what the models can and can't do.

articles.title: AI's Top Startups Are Barely Publishing Their Research
articles.summary: Science investigation finds leading AI startups increasingly treat research as proprietary — a stark shift from the era of open publication that built the field.
